problem:
| $x$ | **$-4$** | **$-2$** | **$0$** | **$2$** | **$4$** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $y$ | $-7$ | $10$ | $-2$ | $1$ | $-5$ |

The vector of coefficients of the curve $y={\beta }_{1}x+{\beta }_{2}{x}^{2}+{\beta }_{3}{x}^{3}$ that best fits the data above can be found using polynomial regression as 

$$
[\begin{aligned}{\beta }_{1} \\ {\beta }_{2} \\ {\beta }_{3}\end{aligned}]=({X}^{T}\,X)^{-1}{X}^{T}y,
$$

where $X$ is the corresponding design matrix and $y$ is the observation vector. Which of the following is the design matrix $X$ in this context?
worked_solution:
| $x$ | **$-4$** | **$-2$** | **$0$** | **$2$** | **$4$** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $y$ | $-7$ | $10$ | $-2$ | $1$ | $-5$ |

The coefficients of the curve 

$$
y={\beta }_{1}x+{\beta }_{2}{x}^{2}+{\beta }_{3}{x}^{3}
$$

that best fits the data can be found as the least-squares solution $\overset{^}{\beta }$ to the system 

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{X}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}-4 & (-4)^{2} & (-4)^{3} \\ -2 & (-2)^{2} & (-2)^{3} \\ 0 & {0}^{2} & {0}^{3} \\ 2 & {2}^{2} & {2}^{3} \\ 4 & {4}^{2} & {4}^{3}\end{aligned}]}}\overset{\beta }{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}{\beta }_{1} \\ {\beta }_{2} \\ {\beta }_{3}\end{aligned}]}} & =\overset{y}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}-7 \\ 10 \\ -2 \\ 1 \\ -5\end{aligned}]}},\end{aligned}
$$

where $X$ is the design matrix, $\beta $ is the parameter vector, and $y$ is the observation vector.
